transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 682 Pine Mountain Court?
Yes, this is 682 Pine Mountain Court. Just four people here, no water inside, and we’re all safe.
Thank you for confirming your safety and address. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are four people here total, and everyone can come to the phone.

Thanks for letting us know everyone can speak on the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just want to clarify — no one is bedbound or uses a wheelchair, so no motorized equipment needed.
Got it, no one here needs special equipment to leave. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside the home right now. Just four people here, all able to leave on their own.
Thank you for the update, everyone is accounted for. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, we don’t have a high-clearance truck, boat, or any free seats in a vehicle to help neighbors.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — four people, no water inside yet. Just to clarify, I’m safe and no one needs to leave alone.
Thanks for confirming your safety and clarity. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
